KISWAHILI — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matamshi Bora Sauti.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Matamshi Bora Sauti.
